title: Chinta Mani Library v2.3.0 Update (Build 27) — Universal QR Portal
releaseNotes: Universal QR Member Portal: Permanent QR code for student self-service & admissions
Self Registration: Multi-step form with live selfie capture & Aadhaar uploads
Smart Seat Allocation: 24h plans automatically reserve seats; 6h/12h admin allocated
Payment Verifications: Direct UPI pay with screenshot proof & 1-tap admin verification
Member Complaints Desk: Ticket tracking & resolution for AC, power, seating & Wi-Fi
6-Month Activity Timeline: Detailed member history of payments, seats & complaints
Seat Reallocation: Support for blocking, unblocking, and editable seat transfers
